description: A React component named TreeView that renders a nested, expandable, searchable JSON viewer with features like auto-expansion of search matches, expand/collapse all, and custom rendering of primitive values including currency formatting.

methods.name: escapeRegExp
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for use in a regular expression.

methods.name: toDisplayString
methods.description: Converts a value to a JSON-like string representation for display.

methods.name: shouldTruncate
methods.description: Determines if a string or value should be truncated based on length.

methods.name: truncateIfNeeded
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights parts of text matching a regex by wrapping them in a span with a class.

methods.name: addAncestors
methods.description: Adds ancestor paths of a given path to a set for auto-expansion.
